title: A Barrel of Trouble
desc: The windmill's great sails sweep low over the narrow plank across the mill race. A steady trickle of sheep will be swatted one after another — gather them up and send them over all at once.
hint: Hold the flock in the little pen with a Blocker. When everyone is out, a well-timed Boom on the Blocker lets them all dash across between two sweeps.
